Metadata.title: Parkfairy staff
Metadata.description: Review what people send in to Parkfairy.

SignIn.title: Staff sign-in
SignIn.description: For Parkfairy staff only. You will be asked for your two-factor code next.

TwoFactor.title: Two-factor verification
TwoFactor.description: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app.
TwoFactor.backupDescription: Enter one of the backup codes you saved when you set up two-factor authentication. Each one works once.

Validation.backupCodeRequired: Enter one of your backup codes

Forms.invalidSummary: {count, plural, one {# field needs your attention} other {# fields need your attention}}

AuthErrors.INVALID_EMAIL_OR_PASSWORD: The email or password is incorrect. If you’ve just signed up, first follow the link we emailed you.
AuthErrors.INVALID_CODE: That code is not valid. Try again.
AuthErrors.OTP_HAS_EXPIRED: That code has expired. Try a new one.
AuthErrors.TOO_MANY_ATTEMPTS: Too many attempts. Sign in again to get a new code.
AuthErrors.ACCOUNT_TEMPORARILY_LOCKED: Too many wrong codes. Try again in {minutes, plural, one {# minute} other {# minutes}}.
AuthErrors.ACCOUNT_SUSPENDED: This account has been suspended, so you can’t sign in. Contact Parkfairy support if you think this is a mistake.
AuthErrors.INVALID_TWO_FACTOR_COOKIE: Your verification session expired. Sign in again.
AuthErrors.TOO_MANY_REQUESTS: Too many attempts. Wait a moment and try again.
AuthErrors.UNKNOWN: Something went wrong. Please try again.
AuthErrors.INVALID_BACKUP_CODE: That backup code is not valid or has already been used.
AuthErrors.INVALID_TOKEN: This link has expired or has already been used. Request a new one.

NotFound.title: We couldn’t find that page
NotFound.description: The link may be broken or the page may have moved.

Error.title: Something went wrong
Error.description: This page couldn’t be loaded. Please try again.

not-staff.title: This account is not staff
not-staff.text: These screens are for Parkfairy staff. Sign out and use a staff account, or go to the public site.

no-second-factor.title: Turn on two-factor first
no-second-factor.text: Staff screens only open for accounts with two-factor verification on. Turn it on from your account page on the public site, then sign in here again.

standing.enrolLink: Open your account page on the public site

forbidden.title: You can’t see this
forbidden.text: The server did not allow this request. Sign out and in again, and check that your account has two-factor verification on.

unavailable.title: This could not be loaded
unavailable.text: The server did not answer. Reload the page in a moment.

review.lastNote: What was last asked of the owner
review.ownersLead: Tax numbers show only their last three characters. Everyone paid a share is checked here.
review.ownersCaption: The listing’s owners and their details
review.proofs: Proof of the right to rent
review.proofsLead: Opening a document is recorded in the audit log, with your name.
review.moderation: Take it down or bring it back

audit.title: Audit log
audit.lead: Everything staff change, and every proof document opened. Newest first. It cannot be edited or deleted.

user.two_factor_removed: Two-factor authentication removed from an account

audit.caption: Audit log
audit.disputeLink: Open the booking of the dispute

users.title: Accounts
users.lead: Find a person’s account to help them, by their whole email address. Nothing else about accounts is listed here.

bookings.title: Bookings
bookings.lead: Find a booking by the reference the driver quotes. Nothing else about bookings is listed here.

cancellers.owner: By an owner, a manager or support

booking.refundLine: {status}{amount, select, other { · {amount}}}{count, plural, =0 {} one {, asked again once} other {, asked again # times}}

disputeReasons.bank_cannot_process: The bank could not process it

payments.title: Payments
payments.lead: What needs support’s attention on money matters. Open a booking to act on it.

open.heading: Disputes still open at the bank
open.hint: Answered in Stripe’s dashboard; shown here to be seen. A dispute with no response sent is lost when it falls due.
open.caption: Disputes still open at the bank

payments.more: Showing the first {max, number}; there are more.

lost.heading: Lost disputes waiting for a decision
lost.hint: Each holds the owners’ payout for that booking until you decide who bears the loss.
lost.caption: Lost disputes waiting for a decision

failed.heading: Refunds that failed
failed.hint: Stripe took the refund and it failed, so the driver is owed money.
failed.caption: Refunds that failed

AdminReview.own: You own, co-own or manage this listing, so someone else on the staff has to decide it.
AdminReview.notWaiting: This listing is not waiting for a decision. Its status is: {status}.

approve.heading: Approve
approve.text: The listing goes live, and the owners who are paid a share are marked verified.
approve.question: Publish this listing now?

changes.heading: Send back for changes
changes.text: The owner reads your note, fixes the listing and sends it in again.
changes.hint: Plain words, up to {max, number} characters. The owner sees this exactly as written.

approved.title: Listing approved
approved.text: It is live, and the owners will be told. The decision is in the audit log.

changes.title: Listing sent back
changes.text: The owner will be told and can send it in again. The decision is in the audit log.

AdminLookup.hint: The whole address, as the person gave it.

AdminErrors.NOT_IN_REVIEW: Someone decided this listing already, or the owner took it back. The page now shows where it stands.
AdminErrors.OWN_LISTING: You own, co-own or manage this listing, so someone else has to decide it.
AdminErrors.OWNER_DETAILS_MISSING: An owner changed their details since they sent this in, and they are incomplete now: {owners}. The listing can’t go live until they are filled in; send it back instead.
AdminErrors.OWN_ACCOUNT: This is your own account, so someone else on the staff has to do this.
AdminErrors.STAFF_ACCOUNT: This is a staff account. Staff recover their own two-factor authentication by hand, not here.
AdminErrors.NO_TWO_FACTOR: This account has no two-factor authentication now: someone may have removed it already. The page now shows where it stands.
AdminErrors.NOT_PUBLISHED: This listing is not live now, so it can’t be suspended: someone may have done it already. The page now shows where it stands.
AdminErrors.NOT_SUSPENDED: The suspension is already lifted: someone may have done it. The page now shows where it stands.
AdminErrors.ALREADY_SUSPENDED: This account is suspended already. The page now shows where it stands.
AdminErrors.NOT_CANCELLABLE: This booking can’t be cancelled now: it has begun, or it is already off. The page now shows where it stands.
AdminErrors.REFUND_NOT_FAILED: This booking has no failed refund now: someone may have dealt with it already. The page now shows where it stands.
AdminErrors.TRANSFER_MADE: The owners were paid already, so the refund can only be marked settled, not asked for again.
AdminErrors.NOT_LOST: This dispute is not lost, so there is nothing to decide yet. The page now shows where it stands.
AdminErrors.ALREADY_DECIDED: Someone decided this dispute already. The page now shows where it stands.
AdminErrors.MFA_REQUIRED: Two-factor verification must be on for your account.
AdminErrors.INVALID_ORIGIN: This request did not come from this site. Reload the page and try again.
AdminErrors.SESSION_ENDED: Your session has ended. Sign in again; nothing you typed here was sent.
AdminErrors.TOO_MANY_REQUESTS: Too many decisions in a short time. Wait a moment and try again.
AdminErrors.UNKNOWN: Something went wrong. Please try again.
AdminErrors.DISPUTED: This booking is disputed at the bank, so it can’t be cancelled or its refund asked for again: the driver could be paid twice. Settle the dispute first.
AdminErrors.NOT_HELD: No payout is held for this booking (it was paid out, or nothing was kept), so the owners can’t be made to bear the loss. Only “Parkfairy bears the loss” can be recorded.

AdminUser.own: This is your own account, so someone else on the staff has to change its security.
AdminUser.staff: This is a staff account. Staff recover their own two-factor authentication by hand, not here.
AdminUser.none: This account has no two-factor authentication to remove.
AdminUser.heading: Remove two-factor authentication
AdminUser.text: Only after you have checked who is asking. The person is signed out on every device, their password is cancelled (they set a new one by email), their address is emailed, and your note stays in the audit log for good.
AdminUser.note: How did you check who they are?
AdminUser.hint: A ticket reference and the kind of check, up to {max, number} characters, for example “Video call, ticket 4821”. No names, ID numbers or document details: the note stays in the audit log for good.
AdminUser.question: Remove two-factor authentication from this account now? The person is signed out on every device and must set a new password by email.
AdminUser.doneText: The person is signed out everywhere, their password is cancelled and their address has been emailed so they can set a new one. The removal, with your note, is in the audit log.

AdminModeration.own: You own, co-own or manage this listing, so someone else on the staff has to do this.
AdminModeration.none: This listing is neither live nor suspended, so there is nothing to take down or bring back.

suspend.heading: Suspend this listing
suspend.text: It leaves search and can’t be booked. The primary owner is emailed, and all its owners and managers read your note on their dashboard, so write it for them.
suspend.note: Why is it suspended? (its owners read this)
suspend.hint: Plain words, up to {max, number} characters. The owners see this exactly as written.
suspend.cancelBookings: {count, plural, one {Also cancel its # upcoming booking} other {Also cancel its # upcoming bookings}}
suspend.cancelHint: Drivers are refunded in full and emailed. A stay that has begun is not cancelled. Left unticked, bookings that exist stand.
suspend.question: Suspend this listing now?
suspend.questionCancel: {count, plural, one {Suspend this listing and cancel its # upcoming booking now? The driver is refunded in full.} other {Suspend this listing and cancel its # upcoming bookings now? The drivers are refunded in full.}}

reinstate.heading: Reinstate this listing
reinstate.text: It is live again and can be booked. The primary owner is emailed. Your note stays in the audit log; the owners don’t read it.
reinstate.note: Why is it reinstated? (for the audit log only)
reinstate.hint: A ticket reference and a few words, up to {max, number} characters.
reinstate.question: Put this listing back on the site now?

suspended.title: Listing suspended
suspended.text: It is off the site and the primary owner is told. The suspension is in the audit log.

reinstated.title: Listing reinstated
reinstated.text: It is live again and the primary owner is told. The decision is in the audit log.

AdminAccount.own: This is your own account, so someone else on the staff has to change it.
AdminAccount.staff: This is a staff account. Staff accounts are not suspended here.

suspend.heading: Suspend this account
suspend.text: The person can’t sign in, is signed out on every device, and is emailed that the account is suspended, without your reason. Nothing they own is changed.
suspend.liveListings: {count, plural, one {They are the primary owner of # live listing, which stays live until you suspend it.} other {They are the primary owner of # live listings, which stay live until you suspend them.}}
suspend.hint: A ticket reference and a few words, up to {max, number} characters. The person never sees this.
suspend.question: Suspend this account now? The person is signed out on every device.

reinstate.heading: Reinstate this account
reinstate.text: The person can sign in again with their password and is emailed that the suspension is lifted. Nothing is republished or restored for them.
reinstate.note: Why is it reinstated? (for the audit log only)
reinstate.hint: A ticket reference and a few words, up to {max, number} characters.
reinstate.question: Lift the suspension of this account now?

suspended.title: Account suspended
suspended.text: The person is signed out and told. The suspension, with your note, is in the audit log.

reinstated.title: Account reinstated
reinstated.text: The person can sign in again and is told. The decision is in the audit log.

AdminBookingLookup.hint: The reference the driver quotes, like K7M4-Q2ZD.

AdminBooking.hint: A ticket reference and a few words, up to {max, number} characters.
AdminBooking.nothing: Nothing to do here: this booking can’t be cancelled now, and has no failed refund or lost dispute waiting.

cancel.heading: Cancel this booking
cancel.text: The driver is refunded in full and told, and so are the owners, who won’t receive a share of it. Your note stays in the audit log.
cancel.question: Cancel this booking now? The driver is refunded in full: {amount}.
cancel.doneText: The refund is on its way, and the driver and the owners are told. It is in the audit log.

retry.heading: Ask Stripe for the refund again
retry.text: The refund failed after Stripe took it (a closed card, say), so the money is back with Parkfairy. A new attempt may fail the same way. It is sent within a few minutes.
retry.note: Why try again? (for the audit log only)
retry.question: Ask Stripe to refund {amount} again now?
retry.doneText: It is queued and goes within minutes. If it fails again, this page shows it.

settle.heading: Mark the refund settled
settle.text: Use this once the driver has been paid another way. The failed refund stays on record, and nothing more is sent.
settle.note: How was the driver paid? (for the audit log only)
settle.question: Mark this refund of {amount} as settled? Nothing more will be sent to the driver.
settle.doneText: It stays on record as failed and settled by hand. It is in the audit log.

dispute.heading: Decide who bears this loss
dispute.text: The bank sided with the driver ({amount}). Until you decide, the owners’ payout for this booking is held. The owners are told either way. After you choose, a note and one more question follow.
dispute.parkfairy_bearsHint: The owners’ payout for this booking is released as normal.
dispute.owners_bearHint: Their payout for this booking is cancelled for good.
dispute.parkfairy_bearsText: The owners’ payout is released as normal, and they are told.
dispute.owners_bearText: Their payout for this booking is cancelled for good, and they are told.
dispute.parkfairy_bearsQuestion: Release the owners’ payout and bear this loss?
dispute.owners_bearQuestion: Cancel the owners’ payout for this booking for good? The owners are told.
dispute.parkfairy_bearsDone: The owners’ payout is released and they are told. It is in the audit log.
dispute.owners_bearDone: The owners’ payout is cancelled and they are told. It is in the audit log.
dispute.textPaid: The bank sided with the driver ({amount}). Nothing is held: the owners were paid already, or nothing of this booking was kept for them. Only “Parkfairy bears the loss” can be recorded, and the owners are not told.
